_comment: F2 compat uppercase-hex token never matches; ignored not invalid_session_id; missing rejects. RED via --validate-config.
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false
bearer_session_compat = true

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"
session_header = "x-affinity"
session_missing = "reject"

[[models]]
name = "gem-chat"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"
name: m4_compat_gemini_uppercase_ignored_missing
